records.rule: Object identity is stable; pathname and provider locator are views/locations that may change.
Never conflate OBJECT, LOCATION, PATH and POLICY.
Catalogue/search is the fast local knowledge plane and does not require every provider to be online.
Extended attributes are first-class typed/provenanced metadata and may drive query-folder views.
A folder may be a filter/view; excluding an entry from that view is not destruction of the underlying object.
Ordered union/search paths can overlay unrelated namespace roots; first visible match shadows lower duplicates without copying data.
Fluid aliases resolve the current target at access time and may have route-specific write semantics.
DIRECT, TRACKED, COPY_ON_WRITE, VERSIONED and READ_ONLY are access-route mutation behaviours, not object identities or permission grants.
LIVE/TEST/DEVELOPMENT are generation-pinned namespace projections; TEST/DEV may share immutable Live refs until they diverge.
Promotion is explicit and generation-pinned; stale targets fail rather than silently rebasing.
Charge workspace to the real capacity domain. Do not add free space reported through multiple paths on the same filesystem.
Do not add independent nodes into one workspace capacity unless the job/storage contract explicitly supports distribution.
Reserve expected working bytes before execution so concurrent jobs cannot both spend the same free space.
Removable-provider identity survives mount-path changes and disconnection; offline replicas remain catalogued.
Performance and availability are separate measured properties. USB can be intermittent yet fast enough; remote cloud can be available yet slow.
Physical durability is insufficient: provider/account/service lifecycle determines whether a copy can count as safe.
DISPOSABLE or non-STABLE storage is workspace, not safety; never use it as the sole durable replica.
TERMINATING service capacity is not admissible for new workspace.
Compare moving the job to data with moving data to the job; large media makes locality economically and operationally significant.
Locality never overrides hard security/legal/access/runtime/hardware eligibility.
Include expected output and required durable export in placement movement cost, not just input transfer.
Move large objects through bounded source/sink chunks; never require whole-object memory.
Flush sink before advancing checkpoint; fence resume against source identity.
COPY, VERIFY and COMMIT are distinct. Process exit zero is not durable completion by itself.
Google Drive is initially durable/offload/catalogue storage with measured performance, not assumed execution workspace.
Storage publishes facts; allocator places, Queue Fabric dispatches, security authorizes, SSC owns semantic source history, consumers own domain meaning.
Keep the Gopher sphere separate from executable Storage Fabric and update it when architecture or qualified baseline changes.
Before reconstructing a COPYING transfer, reconcile local progress with provider-authoritative resume evidence when the sink supports it.
Advance checkpoints only by provider-acknowledged bytes; reopen the source at the acknowledged offset and resend any unacknowledged suffix.
A resumable session URI is bearer-like capability material; keep it out of generic catalogue/checkpoints and place restart persistence behind provider-private secure authority.
Acquire provider credentials through short-lived leases, use them transiently for the request, then retire them; do not retain Authorization in evidence.
The BashQueues Google Drive account is disposable TEST infrastructure; account intent/lifecycle can make an otherwise durable provider unsafe as the sole replica.
Stable nodeId is separate from cloud provider and current network endpoint; endpoint changes do not redefine the node.
A block device observed by fdisk is not allocatable storage until explicitly admitted and represented by a StoragePool plus capacity observation.
Unknown or unobserved node capacity is zero for planning; never invent workspace from provider type or device presence.
Storage may emit per-node feasibility/movement evidence across the inventory, but Job-to-Node retains hard eligibility, ranking and lease authority.
Current test fleet identities are ed209a/ed209b Oracle, ed209c Microsoft Azure disposable trial workspace, and ed209d AWS; endpoint addresses are operational observations rather than identity.
